# Development

<!-- awf:edit setup: from .awf/docs/parts/development/setup.md -->
## Setup

Go 1.26 or newer, nothing else. Clone, then `go test ./...` to confirm a green
baseline. The pinned awf binary is fetched on demand by `.awf/bootstrap.sh`.


<!-- awf:edit command-runner: from .awf/docs/parts/development/command-runner.md -->
## Command runner

`./x` wraps every repo task: `gate` (tests + vet, with no arguments) and `test` (forwarding Go test arguments),
and the awf verbs `render`, `check`, `audit`, `new`,
which run the release pinned in `.awf/bootstrap.sh`.


<!-- awf:edit dependencies: from .awf/docs/parts/development/dependencies.md -->
## Dependencies

None beyond the Go standard library. awf is a development-time tool, not a module
dependency; it never appears in `go.mod`.
